messages:
reconciler-bot: ALERT: configuration mismatch detected between prod and staging (auto-remediation: dry-run). 3 diffs: gpu_pool.size (prod=8 staging=6), nodepool taints (missing prod:gpu=true), subnet tags mismatch. Plan output uploaded: https://ci.redwood/infracheck/1829/plan
maria: ok seeing this. Was an apply attempted or just a plan?
reconciler-bot: dry-run only, no apply. It created a proposed PR in infra repo with the terraform plan as a draft. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/1203
kai: good — if that had auto-applied we'd have scaled down GPUs mid-rollout. we need to ensure reconcile-mode != auto-apply for gpu pools. :warning:
oliver: I noticed two training jobs were evicted around 1828999900, might be related. Pods got rescheduled to cheaper nodes and OOM'd.
sre-oncall: confirmed, saw eviction spikes and restart storms. I shifted the affected jobs to the fallback pool. No customer-facing latency impact yet but the batch queues backed up.
devops: quick snippet from the module that's differing — staging has an override we forgot to sync:
```
module "gpu_pool" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@.../infra.git//modules/gpu"
  node_count = var.gpu_node_count
}
```
maria: where did the staging override come from? manual run?
kai: someone ran terraform apply in the staging workspace last week to test a kernel upgrade. workspace isolation was respected but we didn't push the change back to main. human diff produced the mismatch.
reconciler-bot: note: OPA policy 'no-implicit-gpu-scale' currently set to warn in staging, enforce in prod. That mismatch allows staging to diverge.
oliver: Request: can we set OPA enforcement to block tf apply in non-approved workspaces until PR exists?
sre-oncall: also add an alert for 'reconcile dry-run created PR' so oncall knows about config churn. Right now it just shows up as noise in infra-metrics.
devops: I'll open a small PR to change the reconcile config to require a canary tag for auto-remediation and disable auto-apply for pools with label `critical=true`.
maria: action items: 1) @devops open PR for reconcile policy (ETA EOD) 2) @kai revert manual staging override or rebase it into infra/main (ETA today) 3) @oliver confirm bumped job restarts are stable (ETA 1h)
kai: I'll rebase the staging change into a branch and link the PR. won't merge until we have canary config in place.
reconciler-bot: created issue infra#457: "Prevent implicit GPU auto-applies; tighten reconcile flow" and attached plan output.
oliver: FYI — logging snippet from the eviction controller:
```
2026-11-09T14:05:21Z eviction-controller pod/worker-123 evict: reason=NotEnoughResources nodes:gpu=6 required=8
```
maria: thanks all. let's not let auto-remediate touch GPU pools until we have policy change. I'll update runbook to call out this scenario. :thumbsup:
sre-oncall: I'll keep monitoring and will escalate if job backlog grows.
reconciler-bot: closing dry-run alert (status: awaiting human PR)."
